jobs.name: 01-chalk-outline
jobs.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE standalone image for a five-frame logo material-switch animation. Input image 1 is Rouse High School's official school seal, used ONLY as identity reference: extract and faithfully preserve the distinctive central ornate blackletter capital R, including its detached curved top flourish, narrow left stem, tall right bowl, sweeping lower swash and long curved descending right leg. Do not use an ordinary font R or invent another school mark. Remove the circular seal, outer ring, school name, gold background and all text. Input image 2 is a STYLE reference from a video, not the logo to reproduce; do not copy its triangle or TW letters. Output a square 1024x1024 image. Exactly one centered R with its entire shape and flourishes visible, bounding box approximately x=262..762, y=222..802, upright and straight-on. Pure solid black #000000 background edge to edge. Strict monochrome white, off-white, gray and black. No captions, borders, watermark, props, hands or extra symbols. Keep R recognizable and negative spaces open. Medium: hand-drawn white chalk outline. Trace the exterior and interior contours of the exact R with a single thin slightly wobbly chalk/grease-pencil line; leave the body black and unfilled. Small natural pressure variations, tiny gritty breaks, charming human irregularity. Simple confident handmade contour drawing, not a polished vector or neon outline. Preserve the distinctive detached flourishes as outline shapes.
